prompt_md: There are 100 politicians. At least one is honest, and of any two you pick, at least one is crooked. How many of them are honest?
prompt_short: 100 politicians, one honest, any pair has a crook. How many honest?
hint_md: What would happen if two of them were honest?
explain_intuition_md: If two were honest, you could pick exactly those two, and neither would be crooked. So there can't be two. With at least one, there's exactly one, not half of them.
